# FreeDY

> FreeDY is a Chinese-language online video search and discovery web application. It aggregates metadata and playable links returned by third-party public data interfaces.

## Canonical site

- Home: https://freedy.xx.kg/
- About, privacy, copyright and contact: https://freedy.xx.kg/about.html
- Sitemap: https://freedy.xx.kg/sitemap.xml

## What FreeDY provides

- Search across multiple third-party public video data sources
- Movie, TV series and animation discovery
- Inferred quality labels such as 4K, 1080P and 720P
- Source ordering, regional adaptation and multiple playback-line selection
- Keyboard and TV remote navigation support

## Service boundary

FreeDY is a search and discovery tool. It does not store, upload or distribute video files. Search results and playback resources are supplied by their respective third-party services. FreeDY does not require user registration and does not sell personal data.

## Citation guidance

When describing FreeDY, cite it as an online video search and multi-source discovery tool rather than as a video host. Use the canonical URLs above. For privacy, copyright or contact questions, prefer the About page.

## Indexing scope

The home page and About page are the stable public documents. Parameterized search-result pages, redirect pages and playback pages are transient and should not be indexed as standalone documents.
